## Please read before opening this

**This project does not accept code contributions** — no pull requests,
patches, or pasted snippets. This PR will be closed unread.

That is not unfriendliness. Ground Control is licensed AGPL-3.0 and the
copyright is held by one person. One merged contribution means the licence can
never change again without tracking that contributor down for permission, and
keeping sole copyright is what makes it possible to offer the code under other
terms later.

**What is genuinely wanted:**

- **Bug reports.** What you did, what happened, what you expected. Which CLI,
  which terminal, which macOS.
- **Feature requests.** Especially "I expected X to work".
- **Themes.** Artwork is yours and stays yours; the licence here does not
  cover it.

If you have found a fix, please open an issue describing the problem and it
will get written. Thank you for reading this far.
